title: Crispy Miso-Roasted Chicken Thighs with White Wine Miso Pan Sauce
originalTitle: Crispy Miso-Roasted Chicken Thighs with White Wine Miso Pan Sauce
ingredients: 4 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs (or 1.5 lbs boneless skin-on thighs)
2 tbsp white or red miso paste
2 shallots, finely minced & 3 cloves garlic, smashed
1/3 cup dry white wine or sake + 2 tbsp mirin
1 tsp rice vinegar or lemon juice & 2 scallions, thinly sliced
instructions: Pat chicken thighs dry, season lightly with salt and pepper, and place skin-side down in a cold cast-iron or stainless skillet. Turn heat to medium-high and render for 10–12 minutes until skin is shatteringly crisp; flip and cook 5 minutes more. Remove chicken.
Pour off all but 1 tbsp rendered chicken fat, add shallots and smashed garlic, and sauté for 2 minutes.
Deglaze the pan with white wine (or sake) and mirin, then whisk in chicken stock and miso paste until smooth.
Simmer 3–4 minutes until reduced by half, swirl in cold butter and rice vinegar for a glossy emulsion, and spoon around the crispy chicken thighs.
